name: blackswan-voltarget
description: The VOLATILITY-TARGET screen (B1 §2) — a deliberately crude, deterministic sizing rule run to falsify the multi-week env rewire cheaply. Measured over the 12 symbols on disk, trailing 20d RETURN predicts next 20d return at +0.015 (noise) while trailing 20d VOL predicts next 20d vol at +0.426 (positive on 12/12); six consecutive nulls in this campaign all bet on the first quantity and nothing has ever traded the second. This screen trades ONLY the second: no directional view, just a long book re-sized to a causal, expanding-median vol target, capped, rebalanced every N bars, fees charged on turnover both ways. It is a separate entry point because the env's _position_size() is consulted only at ENTRY (trade_all_crypto_env.py) and a held position is never re-sized, so the env cannot express a continuously vol-targeted book at all. READ THE RIGHT LENS: this strategy DE-RISKS, so it will usually earn LESS raw return than buy-and-hold and return_vs_hold_pct will reject it for working as intended — that is the wrong benchmark here. The objective is oos_sharpe and the hypothesis benchmark is sharpe_vs_hold, with drawdown_vs_hold_pct as the co-primary read (both signed so better-than-hold is POSITIVE). return_vs_hold_pct is still emitted, as context, not as a verdict. mean_exposure / max_exposure report the deployed book so a cash-heavy cell — whose Sharpe would be meaningless — is detectable rather than flattering. Produces no model; its cells are side-experiment evidence, kept in their own record type so they never mix with the single-asset RL run store.

asset.description: Which single asset to size. Daily bars only; the benchmark is buy-and-hold THIS asset, so a cell is a like-for-like comparison against the thing it de-risks. Data directory resolves from the catalog (crypto->binance, stocks->stocks, ETF/commodity->etfs/commodities). Pair the window to the asset's history: stocks/ETFs/commodities start 2018-01 and take the stk-* windows, BTCUSDT takes the plain year windows, the altcoins take alt-*.

vol_window.description: Bars of trailing daily returns in the realized-vol estimate (population stdev, using returns up to and INCLUDING the decision bar). 20 is the horizon the +0.426 vol-persistence finding was measured at; shorter reacts faster and churns more, longer is calmer and slower to de-risk into a shock.

weight_cap.description: Upper clip on the weight. 1.0 is UNLEVERED — the book can only ever de-risk relative to buy-and-hold, which is what the exploratory probe measured. Above 1.0 the rule takes leverage in quiet tape, which is where an uncapped vol target does its damage; the cap is also what keeps a collapsing denominator from demanding infinite size. 0 is the degenerate flat-book control (equity ends at exactly 1.0, zero fees).

rebalance_days.description: Bars between re-sizings; the weight is held constant in between. This is the turnover — and therefore the cost — control, and cost is the term that killed several earlier arms of this campaign. A continuously re-sized vol target trades every bar and pays for it.

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost, charged on both the increase and the decrease of the weight, and charged once on the buy-and-hold benchmark so the two curves are netted the same way. Liquid equity/ETF/gold ~0.0002 (2bps); crypto ~0.001.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample span is ACCOUNTED. The vol estimator and its expanding median may look back into the train span for their formation history — that is the point of an expanding target — but only the test window's P&L is reported.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the screen is fully deterministic (no training, no sampling), so seeds are not swept; three identical cells would fake replication.
